notes.observation: Unit 2 ends `மாற்றத்தை ஏற்படுத்தி` and unit 3 begins `விட்டது`.
Padma's `போய் வருகிறேன்` is retrospectively read as a farewell not to hospital but to a peaceful final place.
notes.translation_action: Preserve retrospective foreshadowing without making her consciously predict death.

notes.observation: Blood is sent to Guindy; result arrives only after twenty days with historical diagnostic wording `குதிரை வேக க்ஷயரோகக் காய்ச்சல்`.
notes.translation_action: Preserve delay and historical wording conservatively; do not modernize diagnosis beyond evidence.

notes.observation: Coffee-at-bus-stand memory marks narrator's recognition of Padma's patience and his own hardness.
notes.translation_action: Preserve self-critique and change in behaviour.

notes.observation: Palai-kali deer image becomes a self-accusation: even a deer gave shade to its mate, while he could not protect Padma.
notes.translation_action: Translate the embedded line functionally without importing an external canonical translation.

notes.observation: Friend Arunachalam still urges the Pudukottai meeting after seeing Padma; narrator frames decision as `stone heart or sense of duty?` and says he himself does not know which won.
Return finds Padma dead at age twenty after three years of marriage; narrator kisses her forehead before assembled women.
notes.translation_action: Keep restraint, guilt and intimacy without embellishment.
